card.name: Spots where a liquid word comes next
card.fires_on: Linking words, commas or spaces just before an expected liquid noun such as blood, juice, milk, water, wine or a volume in mL. It fires on the slot before the liquid word, not on the liquid itself.

modes.label: Before a drink or fluid
modes.description: Gap or small word right before a named beverage or fluid, such as wine, milk, juice or water.

card.writes: It suppresses the word liquid and its variants, so it lowers the chance that the generic word liquid is the next word.
card.plain: It marks places where a liquid such as a drink or blood is about to be named.
